methodNote: Stage 4 resolves a large bounded block of the remaining downloaded-image queue. Clearly square/pseudo-square Chinese-style cash forms enter the main corpus; visually coherent solid regional coinage and circular/non-square forms are moved to related evidence. Mixed categories remain pending rather than being forced into a binary classification.

families.title: Semirechye two-runic-sign square-hole cash
families.zh: 七河双突厥符号方孔钱
families.dateLabel: Broad 8th–9th century context; exact chronology pending
families.description: Zeno category 13671 groups cash-like AE issues with two runic signs š and γ. Downloaded specimens show pierced square or squarish apertures and belong to the Chinese-style cash-tradition corpus; reading, issuer and chronology remain provisional.
families.question: Issuer, exact reading and catalogue crosswalk require specialist literature review.

families.title: Vakhsh cross-and-tamgha cash
families.zh: 瓦赫什十字与徽记方孔钱
families.description: Northern Tokharistan/Vakhsh AE cash-like issues carrying crosses, tamghas and Sogdian/Bactrian-style elements. Stage-4 visual review confirms square or pseudo-square central apertures/frames across this source group.
families.question: Exact issuer, legend readings, chronology and relationship to neighboring Tokharistan cash traditions remain open.

families.title: Ferghana two-tamgha square-hole cash
families.zh: 费尔干纳双徽记方孔钱
families.description: Two Zeno source records under the Ferghana “Two tamghas” group show clear Chinese-style square-hole cash morphology. The political and chronological attribution remains provisional.
families.question: Crosswalk the tamghas and legends against specialist Ferghana catalogues before canonical attribution.
